title: Simulation code for: Separating Membrane Charging from Spike-Initiation Dwell in Chronaxie: A Persistence-Gated Neuron Model
description: Python simulation code and numerical outputs for the article "Separating Membrane Charging from Spike-Initiation Dwell in Chronaxie: A Persistence-Gated Neuron Model" (submitted to Biological Cybernetics). Includes the Hodgkin-Huxley strength-duration analysis, the persistence-gated leaky integrate-and-fire model, parameter-recovery tests, frequency-response and resonance simulations, and one script per figure that regenerates it from scratch.
